overview.headline: How Americans elect a president from primaries to inauguration

keyPoints.point: An election for president happens every four years on a November Tuesday.
keyPoints.quote: An election for president of the United States happens every four years on the first Tuesday after the first Monday in November.

keyPoints.point: The process of electing a president takes almost two years from start to finish.
keyPoints.quote: The process of electing a president takes almost two years.

keyPoints.point: States and parties hold presidential primaries and caucuses during election year contests.
keyPoints.quote: States and parties hold presidential primaries and caucuses.

keyPoints.point: Electors cast their votes for president in the Electoral College during December.
keyPoints.quote: Electors cast their votes for president in the Electoral College.
